author: root

silhouette.reason: Native1x reads as a small capped person; crown curve and separated shoes fix the old pole silhouette. Vest block still has square sides.

anatomy.reason: All12 poses keep connected sleeve-hand and hip-knee-shoe chains. The nose and neck distinguish profile from front; foreshortening is economical rather than rich.

walking.reason: Decoded frames0/2 swap the raised folded foot and planted supporting calf in front and back. Low forearm opposes that calf; profiles show two grounded/contact phases. Browser samples independently preserve the same3 poses.

pixelCraft.reason: Cap highlights form clusters with a red rim and separated dark temple. No smoothing or broken transparency appears in exact1x/4x browser captures. Close navy shades and flat shorts still limit volume.

identity.reason: Red cap, navy hair and blue vest with gold-red pack remain readable from each direction. Profile carries the rear bag on the correct shoulder and the back retains pocket color.

directionContinuity.reason: Head height and shoulder width agree across12 poses; profile brim points forward and face disappears toward the rear. Bag volume is flatter from behind than in profile.

loop.reason: All4 decoded frames show stepA-idle-stepB-idle at140ms. Last idle and first idle have identical pixels; intentional1px bob repeats without a costume jump. Actual browser shows all3 poses at both scales.

limitations: Square torso/shorts and flat back bag remain.
Art scores are manual judgments; this is not an original-game quality claim.
